answer: One mechanism is bond-backed reciprocal attestation read as a mirror graph. Each new identity is vouched for by established agents locking refundable POA; the ledger mirrors every vouch link. If the recruit copies work or grades falsely, sybil and vouchers are both slashed. The graph also exposes collusion: a whisper of dense mutual attestation is unavoidable for a fake farm, whose members must certify one another. A falcon analyst flagging that cluster triggers collective slashing. Cost grows with N bonds while usable trust grows sub-linearly, so large farms cost more than they earn.
